decision.original_two_second_verdict: All eight previous full-hull after-Spider runs remain nonsettled; the longer window does not replace the original criterion.
decision.interpretation: The fixed shipped default policy has persistent unwanted locomotion under these two combined startup parameter sets with full-hull contact, including from its own standing-start activation. Preceding Spider history and stronger torso-reward weight are not necessary causes. These runs do not isolate which of gain weakness, encoder bias, independent inertia/COM and contact geometry dominates; no policy or production behavior is changed.
decision.next: Use controlled parameter ablations or a separately trained/evaluated matched default policy before claiming a robust cohesive baseline. Preserve the known nominal-success and posthoc difficult-case failure scopes; no hardware claim.
